text:
Priya: quick heads-up — Customer Z is requesting a POC with strict EU geofencing and a per-region sub-processor inventory for their security questionnaire. They explicitly said no US fallback unless legally required. Can we confirm feasibility + any pricing delta? :euro:

Liam: technical note — we support region-based routing. Two relevant modes: `prefer-region` (will try EU then fallback) and `strict-geofence` (reject non-EU). If strict, we need dedicated capacity in eu regions for throughput SLOs. :lock:

Sam: customer will accept eu-west-1 or eu-central-1. They want a short doc mapping which subprocessors touch data in those regions. @Nadia can you pull scoped inventory (only services that can see PII)? :eyes:

Nadia: pulling now. Quick summary (redacted):
- Compute: Redwood Dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 (Redwood-run)
- Cloud infra: AWS eu-west-1 (control plane endpoints in us-east but data plane in eu-west-1)
- Monitoring: Datadog (global account, EU hosted metrics where configured)
- Logging/archives: S3 buckets in eu-west-1; replication currently off for this account
- KMS: customer-managed key in AWS eu-west-1 (recommended for PII)

Carlos: two security asks from the questionnaire: (1) confirm logs do not replicate outside EU during POC, (2) confirm KMS keys are regional and CMK is customer-managed. Both are blockers until answered.

Liam: we can ensure no cross-region log replication for the POC — set `logs_replicate: false` in the deployment config. KMS can be customer-supplied and bound to eu-west-1. Example snippet for ops: 
```yaml
routing:
  policy: strict-geofence
  allowed_regions:
    - eu-west-1
logs:
  replicate: false
keys:
  kms_mode: customer_managed
```

Priya: pricing note — if they insist on strict-geofence and reserved capacity per region, estimate is +30% on top of hosted baseline. Sam, can you confirm whether they'll accept a temporary hosted-with-dedicated-pools estimate or need contractual reserved capacity?

Sam: I'll check with the buyer. Also flag: if we do strict-geofence but no US fallback and traffic spikes, we'll need a burst policy in EU only — that may push to a Dedicated commit. I'll include both scenarios in the quote.

Nadia: attaching a short per-region subproc list for eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 (redacted links): https://redwood.internal/docs/poc/subproc-eu-west-1 (internal)

Carlos: once we have the exact subproc list, I'll sign off. After sign-off, security will issue conditional acceptance for POC with the `logs_replicate: false` constraint.

deploy-bot: POC ticket created: https://redwood.internal/poc/PRJ-789 — checklist includes: subproc inventory, routing config, pricing estimate, legal SecQA answers.

Priya: plan: Sam to get pricing + buyer feedback today, Nadia to confirm final subproc list by EOD, Liam to prepare a test deployment manifest with `strict-geofence` and `replicate:false`. Carlos to review once Nadia posts list. Thanks! :thumbsup:
